name: Hanuman Temple
town_description: Peren is the district headquarters town of Peren district in western Nagaland, set in the foothills adjoining Assam. It is a small administrative centre serving Zeliang Naga communities and a gateway to Intangki National Park. Like most of Nagaland, the town is overwhelmingly Christian, with only a small Hindu population.
